title: Latent-in-the-Middle: On the Security of Cross-Model Latent Communication in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.34278v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As large language models increasingly collaborate in heterogeneous multi-agent systems, latent communication has emerged as an efficient alternative to exchanging natural-language messages. By sharing internal representations, agents can avoid repeatedly processing the same context, reducing communication overhead and prefill computation. One such mechanism is cross-model Key-Value (KV) cache transfer, which uses a learned mapper to translate a source model's KV cache into one a target model can use. However, this handoff means the target model consumes context it did not encode itself, thus calling into question whether its safety alignment still holds.   In this work, we investigate the security implications of latent handoffs by introducing Chasm, a framework characterizing cross-model handoff attacks across three new attack surfaces: the source model, mapper, and handoff mechanism itself. translated_title: 中间潜伏：多智能体系统中跨模型潜在通信的安全性研究
translated_abstract: 随着大型语言模型日益在异构多智能体系统中协作，潜在通信已成为替代自然语言消息交换的一种高效方式。通过共享内部表示，智能体可以避免重复处理相同的上下文，从而降低通信开销和预填充（prefill）计算量。其中一种机制是跨模型键值（KV）缓存传输，它利用一个学习到的映射器将源模型的KV缓存转换为目标模型可用的形式。然而，这种交接意味着目标模型会消费并非由自己编码的上下文，这就引出了一个问题：其安全对齐是否仍然有效。在本工作中，我们通过引入Chasm——一个从三个新攻击面（源模型、映射器和交接机制本身）刻画跨模型交接攻击的框架——来研究潜在交接的安全影响。我们的实验表明，潜在交接……
tldr: 该论文提出Chasm框架，首次系统性地从源模型、映射器和交接机制三个新攻击面刻画了跨模型KV缓存交接攻击，揭示了多智能体系统中的潜在通信可能破坏目标模型安全对齐的安全风险。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Chasm, a framework that characterizes cross-model handoff attacks across three new attack surfaces (the source model, the mapper, and the handoff mechanism itself), revealing that latent communication in multi-agent systems can undermine the target model's safety alignment.
